task: Develop test cases to determine if a program is functionally correct.
statement: Develop test cases and test a given program.

task: Perform code review for a teammate.
statement: Communicate clearly and collaboratively to provide feedback to a teammate about a piece of code.

task: Work on a team effectively.
statement: Focus on long-term team dynamics and communicate effectively.

task: Make an informed decision regarding which programming language/paradigm to select and use for a specific application.
statement: Apply knowledge of multiple programming paradigms, including their strengths and weaknesses relative to the application to be developed, and select an appropriate paradigm and programming language.

task: Effectively use a programming language’s type system to develop safe and secure software.
statement: Apply knowledge of static type rules for a language to ensure an application is safe, secure, and correct.

task: Develop a version of a CPU-based application to run on a hardware accelerator (GPU, TPU, NPU).
statement: Apply knowledge from systems design to accelerate an application code and evaluate the code speed-up.

task: Produce a white paper assessing the social and ethical implications of collecting and storing data from a new (or existing) application.
statement: Identify the stakeholders and evaluate the potential long-term consequences of the collection and retention of data objects. Consider both potential harm from unintended data use and from data breaches.

task: Secure data from unauthorized access.
statement: Create database views to ensure data access is appropriately limited.

task: Create a database for a new application.
statement: Design the data storage needs (data modeling), assess the social and ethical implications for collecting and storing the data, determine how to store a new application’s data (RDBMS vs NoSQL), and create the database, including appropriate indices.

task: Evaluate the performance of a network.
statement: Evaluate the latency, throughput, congestion, and various service levels of a network.

task: Deploy an application component on an operating system/runtime/virtualized operating system/container.
statement: Identify and mitigate potential problems with deployment; automate setup of deployment environment; set up monitoring of component execution.

task: Improve the performance of a sequential application or component by introducing parallelism.
statement: Evaluate how and when parallelism can improve (or not improve) performance well enough to identify opportunities, as well as implement them and measure the results.

task: Find the performance bottleneck of a given system.
statement: Given a system and its target deployment environment, find its performance bottleneck (e.g., memory, CPU, networking) through analytical derivation or experimental study.

task: Implement an agent to make strategic decisions in a two-player adversarial game with uncertain actions (e.g., a board game, strategic stock purchasing).
statement: Use minimax with alpha-beta pruning, and possible chance nodes (expectiminimax), and heuristic move evaluation (at a particular depth) to solve a two-player zero-sum game.

task: Analyze tabular data (e.g., customer purchases) to identify trends and predict variables of interest.
statement: Use machine learning libraries, data preprocessing, training infrastructures, and evaluation methodologies to create a basic supervised learning pipeline.

task: Critique a deployed machine learning model in terms of potential bias and correct the issues.
statement: Understand, recognize, and evaluate issues of data set bias in AI, the types of bias, and algorithmic strategies for mitigation.

task: Visualize a region’s temperature record.
statement: Given weather data for a region, design and implement an animation depicting temperature changes over time.

task: Evaluate and provide recommendations to improve a user-facing system.
statement: Apply knowledge of usability, accessibility, and inclusivity to evaluate a user-facing system.

task: Determine the aspects of an implementation that require revision to support internationalization.
statement: Evaluate a system to identify culturally-relevant or language-relevant text, symbols, and patterns that may vary by locale.

task: Document the professional implications of a service/software/product for the company that produced it.
statement: Gather information regarding accountability, responsibility and liability assumed by a company when releasing a service/software/product and present it in a coherent and actionable manner.

task: Determine whether to develop an app as a native app or as a cross-platform app.
statement: Understand performance and scalability issues, and evaluate different approaches and tools by carefully considering factors such as app requirements, target audience, time-to-market, and costs.

task: Build and optimize a secure web page for evolving business needs using a variety of appropriate programming languages.
statement: Evaluate potential security hazards and apply optimization techniques.
